title: 建築デザイン基礎
subtitle: Basic Representation of Architectural Design
keywords: Three-dimensional thinking and scale sense 2.Visual expression and communication 3.Spatiality;Material,Mechanics,Beauty 4.Humanity;Memory,Experience,Sensitivity 5.Relationship;History,Environment,Regional Cooperation
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the basic ideas and framework of activities for proposing architectural designs. To be specific, the purpose is to be able to consider about how to proceed architectural design work including structures and design elements by conceptualizing the 3-d composition of architectural design and expressing it with sketches, models, and CAD models. In addition, it will be basic literacy for "Architectural Design Studio I/II" in the second year.
advice: This lesson is composed of following contents. # 1st week; Orientation: Class outline explanation, assignment explanation # 2-6th week; theme 1 "Small space design inspired by basic solids" Students have to propose a new small space by edit a given basic solid by creating a model and a presentation board. # 7-9th week; theme 2 "Reading and communicating spatial design" Students have to create a presentation board that can convey the essence of a real architectural work to others. # 10-14th week; theme 3: "Spatial design inspired by site and context" Students have to propose a new small space based on observation and analysis of the site by creating a model and a presentation board. # 15th week; Review of outcomes and the entire class
requiredKnowledge: Architectural design consists of absorbent of various knowledge and experience, and integration of them into proposals of architecture and cityscapes. Students should actively collect information of the characteristic architecture, its background, the relationship between the space and people, and try to acquire the habit of connecting them to your own ideas. In addition, always check out expression samples such as sketches, models and words in architectural books and magazines and learn to use them yourself.

activityGoals.body: Students can gather information on characteristic architecture and understand their characteristics.
Students can organize their own thoughts and idea, and summarize them in sketches and words.
Students can create a model expressing their own idea and explain it easily to others.
Students can study their own design idea three-dimensionally using 3D CAD.
Students can create presentation board that can convey design concept and composition to others.
